messages:
samira: Heads-up: cutting sample-app SDK release but typegen produced a regen diff that introduces an auth/retry param in a different place across language SDKs. TS now exposes `retry` as a positional arg, Python keeps `opts['retry']`. Smoke tests fail. Repro: `git checkout release && yarn && yarn typegen && npm pack && pip install -e . && ./scripts/smoke.sh`
yves: Uh oh. That sounds like an SDK parity break. Can you paste the minimal diff for the TS output?
samira: TS snippet:
```diff
- authenticate(creds: Credentials, opts?: {timeout?: number, retry?: boolean})
+ authenticate(creds: Credentials, retry?: boolean, opts?: {timeout?: number})
```
harry: And Python?
samira: Python generated client still has `def authenticate(creds, opts=None): retry = opts.get('retry') if opts else None` so callers are unchanged on Python but TS callers break if they used positional args.
changelog-bot: changelog-bot: labeled PR #612 as auto:patch (rule: docs-only)
yves: That's the core problem: changelog automation judged it a patch because no OpenAPI schema change, but the generated language outputs are semantically different. We need to treat cross-SDK signature diffs as semver-impacting.
harry: Short-term: hold the sample-app release and revert the JS/TS SDK publish. Open a revert PR and block the release train.
samira: Revert PR created: https://git.redwood.ai/p/sample-apps/pulls/612-revert-sdk-publish (tagging @yves)
regen-bot: regen-bot: created PR #613 "typegen: restore positional param stability and unify auth/retry across SDKs" (CI: queued)
yves: Plan options: 1) patch typegen to emit consistent signatures across languages and publish 0.12.4, 2) revert SDK artifacts and force manual semver bump if new behavior is intentional. Prefer conservative patch.
harry: Also add a regression test in the codegen suite that checks SDK parity for auth/retry across TS/Python/Go. If any language diverges without explicit OpenAPI change, fail CI.
samira: Filing follow-ups: 1) typegen unit test for stable param ordering, 2) regen-diff parity check across SDKs, 3) update changelog-bot rules to mark cross-language signature diffs as "semver:review", 4) postmortem if revert merges.
yves: I'll add the parity test and a small fix to prefer grouped opts in TS generator. Will link a reproducer gist.
harry: Gist: https://gist.github.com/yves/regen-parity-repro (includes openapi fragment and local typegen outputs for TS and Python)
samira: Holding release until 0.12.4 is published and all smoke tests pass. Will update once green. :thumbsup:
